meta.notes: LIVE (logged out, iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chromium, 2026-11-07): www.threads.com serves the mobile web app - header #barcelona-header, bottom nav, #scrollview - and every fresh load puts a modal sheet over the page: 'Thread on Threads / There's more to do, see and chat about in the app.' with an 'Open Threads' link (a[download] to applink.threads.com) and 'Continue with Instagram'. open-app-sheet matches the body-level wrapper that holds that sheet (1 match on /, /@zuck and a post page); the sheet and the dim backdrop are both inside it, so hiding it removes both, and the page behind still scrolls (no scroll lock was seen: html overflow auto, body visible), so no unlock rule is needed. get-app-header matches the 'Get app' App Store link wrapper in the header (1 match on the same three pages; the desktop layout has no #barcelona-header). login-wall-notice matches 'Log in to see more replies.' on a post (1) and 'Log in to see more from <user>.' on a profile (1); the login link is /login on the profile and /login?show_choice_screen=false&variant=username on the post, so the rule keys on the span+div shape and an href starting with /login. The bottom-nav login entry (a[href='/login/']) and the header 'Log in' button are not matched. related-threads-block matches the section that holds the 'Related threads' heading and the five threads_logged_out_related_posts_* pagelets (1 on a post, 0 on / and /@zuck). The 'Say more with Threads' login sheet (a[aria-label='Open Threads'] to applink.threads.com, no download attribute) is deliberately NOT matched: the two sheets live in separate body-level wrappers, so the login path stays. Not verified: logged-in pages (no account was available), WKWebView rendering, the desktop layout (it shows the login sheet instead of the open-app sheet), other routes (search, notifications, post composer), ads (none were served to the logged-out session) and suggested accounts (none were shown).
